findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_contact_request · Private data: about_valor, get_engagement_information, prepare_contact_request, get_contact_receipt · Public sink: prepare_contact_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_contact_request · Private data: about_valor, get_engagement_information, prepare_contact_request, get_contact_receipt · Public sink: prepare_contact_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
